basic_info.description: In the heart of Jackson Square, but tucked away, this sophisticated residence is in the stunning conversion of a historic building. The stylish interior melds exposed brick walls and soaring ceilings with sleek fixtures and modern conveniences. The main level features soaring ceilings, skylights, hardwood floors and a gas fireplace. Windows look out to the base of the Transamerica Building and Redwood Park, and another wall displays an original early 20th century fresco. For the avid chef, the fabulous open kitchen is equipped with deluxe appliances, stone countertops, and custom cabinetry. Also on this level is a walk-in closet and a limestone bath with glass shower. The lower-level houses an expansive primary bedroom with an office nook, and a double closet. Around the corner is a separate nursery/office with a closet (but no window). The primary bath is outfitted in limestone with a marble-topped vanity and a glass-enclosed shower over tub. This top-floor unit also boasts in-unit AC and laundry. The Gold-Rush era building includes an elevator, storage, shared roof deck with city views, bike storage, and video entry system. 1-car leased garage parking secured nearby. Steps from incredible restaurants, upscale boutiques and cafes.
